answer: Require each agent to register a beacon identity backed by a verifiable work credential: the agent must publish a signed quill-style attestation from a known service proving it completed a real paid task. New identities start with a tiny inlet of trust - only one low-value transaction per day - and the limit rises only after repeated honest attestations. A Sybil attacker must therefore buy or forge a fresh paid-task credential for every fake identity, paying real money and time per account, while honest agents reuse one credential forever.
